proposed_fixes.title: Re-evaluate Dock centre visibility after bands load
proposed_fixes.root_cause: DockControl computes IsCenterVisible while CenterItems is still empty, subscribes to CollectionChanged only during Loaded, and misses the already-completed band population when initialization races ahead of Loaded.
plan: Update DockControl_Loaded to subscribe to CenterItems.CollectionChanged and immediately call UpdateCenterVisibility after the subscription.
Keep the visibility calculation based on IsEditMode or the current CenterItems.Count so preloaded bands are reflected without requiring a later mutation.
Verify the subscription is removed with the existing unload/disposal lifecycle and does not duplicate handlers across monitor-window rebuilds.
Add a regression test or deterministic UI test covering InitializeBands before Loaded and monitor rebuild after RDP reconnect.
verification: Kill and relaunch Microsoft.CmdPal.UI through x-cmdpal://background with pinned centre bands and verify the centre ListView appears on the first launch.
Reconnect RDP or trigger a monitor rebuild and verify the rebuilt dock shows the same pinned bands without Edit Dock > Discard.
Verify an empty centre list remains collapsed and edit mode still shows the intended layout.

confidence.rationale: The issue supplies a concrete ordering trace, UIA before/after evidence, deterministic workaround, and exact source symbols matching the symptom.

issue_context.summary: The Command Palette Dock can create its window and resolve pinned bands while the centre region is still collapsed. Because collection-change subscription occurs only at Loaded and visibility is not recomputed afterward, the rebuilt dock remains an empty strip until edit mode or a later collection change triggers reevaluation.
known_information: PowerToys v0.101.2632; the issue reproduces on startup and on every RDP monitor rebuild.
The report provides exact reproduction steps, UI Automation trees, timing, and a source-level hypothesis in DockControl.xaml.cs.
The workaround Edit Dock > Discard immediately makes the centre list appear without restart.
inferences: The described ordering race is consistent with the missing centre ListView and the fact that a later visibility update fixes the same window.
The safest correction is to recompute visibility after subscription/load; constructor subscription may also work but has broader lifetime implications.
